description: For a "find something on offer" task. GET /api/agent/browse/deals?tab=<tab>, where tab is markdowns, refurbished, top-rated, brands, or door:<slug> for one department. No wallet and no signature. Every item carries cachedAt, which is when that price was true: A selection over rows this site has already cached, so it costs no catalogue call. An unknown tab is refused with 400 rather than guessed at. A sticker discount is not a cheaper order.

tab.description: markdowns, refurbished, top-rated, brands, or door:<slug> with a slug from list_categories.
